providers.reason: ADI is demonstrating strong momentum after a nearly 5% rebound that reclaimed key levels above $400. Recent fundamental tailwinds include a significant Q3 earnings beat with 39.6% revenue growth and expanding operating margins to 39.5%, led by data centers and industrial automation. Management's raised Q4 guidance and bullish analyst upgrades suggest further upside potential.
providers.risk: Broad semiconductor sector sensitivity to macro data and potential profit-taking following its recent 70%+ annual run-up.

providers.reason: Record $4.02B quarter with revenue up ~40% y/y, data-center and industrial-led, and Q4 guided to ~$4.3B. Bernstein ($465) and Susquehanna ($475) reiterate Buy; shares rose 4.3% to $425, above the 50-day and within ~5% of the 52-week high, keeping momentum intact in a strong analog/AI-power tape.
providers.risk: A hawkish Fed presser plus crowded semiconductor positioning could spark profit-taking; the stock is ~21% above GF Value at ~50x earnings and already faded toward $418 after hours.

providers.reason: Strong technical setup (9/10 rating) with recent breakout from lower Bollinger Band on Oct 22. Benefiting from semiconductor sector AI tailwinds and data-center expansion. providers.risk: Trading near recent highs ($425) after strong run, creating pullback risk. Mixed valuation signals with GF Value at $347 suggesting overvaluation. Premium valuation could limit near-term upside despite technical strength.
